wsound_ggrenadeblast89 v1.0.2 validation
================================================

Build commands:
  make clean
  make all
  make check
  ./render_previews

Compiler flags:
  -O2 -std=c89 -pedantic -Wall -Wextra -Werror -Iinclude

Result:
  PASS

Regression hash:
  bd6ede3e

State size:
  native validation host: sizeof(ws_ggb89) = 33304 bytes
  32-bit i386 data model probe: sizeof(ws_ggb89) = 33108 bytes

Static archive:
  native validation host: 24078 bytes
  32-bit i386 compile-only archive: 22210 bytes

Forbidden external-symbol scan:
  malloc/realloc/calloc/free/pow/sin/cos/exp/sqrt = clean

Forbidden-token scan in include/ and src/:
  float/double/malloc/realloc/calloc/free = clean

Preview format:
  44100 Hz
  mono
  signed PCM 16-bit
  no sample reached full-scale clipping in the generated preview set

Transient-jump test, maximum absolute sample-to-sample delta:
  preset 0:  5331
  preset 1:  7393
  preset 2:  9101
  preset 3:  7348
  preset 4: 12261
  preset 5:  8003
  preset 6:  3035
  preset 7:  9708
  threshold: 18000
  result: PASS

Speaker-safe roughness test, first 500 ms:
  preset 2 mean |dx|: 125
  preset 2 mean |d2x|: 104
  preset 4 mean |dx|: 189
  preset 4 mean |d2x|: 146
  result: PASS

Additional 32-bit validation:
  Core compiled with:
    -m32 -std=c89 -pedantic -Wall -Wextra -Werror
  Result:
    PASS, ELF i386 relocatable objects
  This validates 32-bit long/short arithmetic assumptions, but is not a
  Windows/MinGW binary.

v1.0.2 correction validation:
- Fragment density is evaluated every four samples rather than every sample.
- Strong fragment pulses cannot immediately retrigger.
- Fragment noise uses two fixed-point low-pass stages.
- Fragment attack is slew-limited.
- Exact reported montage windows were regenerated for A/B review.
- No heap or floating-point dependency was introduced.

Notes:
- No MinGW cross-compiler was available in the validation environment.
  build_mingw32.bat is included for the user's MSYS2/MinGW32 installation.
- Binary size varies with compiler, architecture, optimization and archive
  format.
- The demo uses stdio only to write WAV files. The core library does not.
